open_points.subject: create-project retry after the created project changes
open_points.text: a retried create never makes a second project while the first keeps its values
open_points.question: What must Registry do when the first project still exists but no longer keeps its creation-time values—for example, after the owner corrects its name, customer or object—and the original create request is retried?
options: Return the existing project with its current corrected values
Refuse the retry without changing anything
Treat the retry as a new create and mint a second project
open_points.default_guess: Keep replay protection across ordinary corrections and return the existing project with its current values; only the expressly named erasure or anonymisation cases become a new create.

witness.initial: The owner creates project P with name N1 and object O; Registry commits P, but the answer is lost.
events: The owner corrects P from name N1 to N2.
The original create request for N1 and O is retried.
outcomes: Registry recognizes the retry and returns the existing corrected project P, so there is still one project.
Registry considers the promise inapplicable because P no longer keeps its values, and either refuses the retry or mints a second project.
witness.observer: The owner, and consumers listing or validating projects

open_points.subject: meaning of values in create-project replay protection
open_points.text: while the first keeps its values
open_points.question: Which stored changes make the first project cease to 'keep its values': only changes to create inputs, or also revision and timestamps, archive status, rooms, artifact pointers, and changes to the referenced Customer?
options: Only loss or alteration of values supplied by the create request
Any change to the Project record, including revision or status
Any change to the project card or linked records, including rooms, pointers or Customer state
open_points.default_guess: Compare the surviving values established by the create request, not later revision, status, rooms, pointers or changes to the referenced Customer.

witness.initial: The owner creates project P and receives its answer; its creation-time name, customer reference and object remain unchanged.
events: The owner adds a room to P.
The original create request is retried.
outcomes: The room is not a value of the create request, so replay protection still applies and Registry returns P.
The room is part of the project card, so P no longer keeps all its values and the conditional duplicate-prevention promise no longer applies.
witness.observer: The owner, who can see whether the retry remains protected and whether another project can be created
